payload.message: You are BuildConductor. Read and execute the instructions in workspace/agents/instant-mesh/BUILD_CONDUCTOR.md. Work in workspace/projects/instant-mesh. Log to logs/build-log.md. Report summary and any ACTION REQUIRED.

You are InvestorScout. Read and execute workspace/agents/instant-mesh/INVESTOR_SCOUT.md. Work in workspace/projects/instant-mesh. Update investor/status.md and logs/investor-log.md. Report summary and any ACTION REQUIRED.
You are StatusWeaver. Read workspace/agents/instant-mesh/STATUS_WEAVER.md. Summarize build-log.md and investor/status.md (and wallet if present). Post short status to chat and update status-board.md.

You are Ignis running a research sweep. Read workspace/notes/research-feeds.md for your feed list and filtering rules. For each RSS feed URL listed: use the fetch_url tool (via the ai-core skill at the URL stored in the AI_CORE_URL environment variable) to fetch the feed. Extract items from the last 48 hours that match the filtering topics. Write a summary to workspace/memory/research/ using today's date as filename (format: YYYY-MM-DD.md). Max 5 bullets per feed, relevant items only. Skip feeds with errors. Append one line to workspace/MEMORY.md: 'Research YYYY-MM-DD: [what was notable]'. Reply with a 2-line summary of findings.

You are Ignis running the weekly self-improvement loop. Follow workspace/notes/self-improvement.md. Steps: 1) List files in workspace/memory/ — read the most recent 7 daily notes (files named YYYY-MM-DD.md). 2) Read workspace/MEMORY.md and workspace/IMPROVEMENTS-BACKLOG.md. 3) Identify patterns: repeated problems, things asked more than once, missing docs, broken flows. 4) Add concrete proposals to IMPROVEMENTS-BACKLOG.md (format: YYYY-MM-DD: description [PENDING] or [SMALL/MEDIUM/LARGE]). 5) Implement any [SMALL] proposals directly — edit the relevant file, mark [DONE]. 6) Update MEMORY.md with 1-3 new learnings if any emerged. 7) Write a daily note entry for today with: 'Self-improvement: found X issues, implemented Y, added Z proposals.' Reply with a brief summary.

You are Ignis running the weekly capability check. Read workspace/notes/capability-loops.md for the full protocol. Steps: 1) List and read the most recent 7 daily notes in workspace/memory/. Read workspace/IMPROVEMENTS-BACKLOG.md. 2) Detect triggers: (a) Execution gate — weeks with only discussion, no concrete file changes; (b) Output pressure — no [DONE] items this week; (c) Problem-driven — same error type appearing multiple times. 3) For each trigger found: add a [CAPABILITY] tagged proposal to IMPROVEMENTS-BACKLOG.md with a concrete rule or skill description. 4) If a capability addition is [SMALL] (edit one file, one rule), implement it directly and mark [DONE]. 5) Update MEMORY.md: 'Tilføjet kompetence: [hvad] pga. [trigger]'. Reply with: triggers found, proposals added, capabilities implemented.
